عبر هبة لفائدة الهيئة الوطنية لترقية الص: Through a donation to the National Foundation for Health Promotion and Research Development
Ooredoo تُرافق الأطفال اليتامى بمناسبة ا: Ooredoo accompanies orphan children on the occasion of the back-to-school season
عشية الدخول المدرسي للموسم 2026-2027، جد: On the eve of the 2026-2027 school year, Ooredoo Algeria renewed its commitment to continuing to stand by orphan children and those from needy families, through a solidarity initiative organized on Thursday, September 10, 2026, in Bentalha in cooperation with the National Foundation for Health Promotion and Research Development (FOREM).
شهدت هذه المبادرة التضامنية حضور رئيس ال: This solidarity initiative was attended by the President of the National Foundation for Health Promotion and Research Development, Professor Mustapha Khiati, and Mr. Ramdane Djazairi, Director of Corporate Affairs, Media Relations and Corporate Social Responsibility at Ooredoo Algeria. This civic initiative falls within Ooredoo Algeria's commitment to contributing to providing the best conditions for orphan children and children from low-income families, enabling them to start their new school year in appropriate conditions, while promoting the principle of equal opportunities and supporting the path of social inclusion.
في إطار شراكتها مع الهيئة الوطنية لترقية: As part of its partnership with the National Foundation for Health Promotion and Research Development (FOREM), Ooredoo Algeria provided a financial contribution allocated for the acquisition of school bags and supplies for orphan children at the psychological care centers in both Bentalha and Zemmouri.
تهدف هذه المبادرة إلى مرافقة الأطفال الم: This initiative aims to accompany the children concerned on the occasion of the back-to-school season, and enable them to start their new school year in the best conditions, by providing the essential school supplies and materials that allow them to continue their educational path in peace and stability.
تُعدّ هذه العملية ثاني مبادرة للدخول الم: This operation is the second back-to-school initiative organized by Ooredoo Algeria in partnership with the National Foundation for Health Promotion and Research Development (FOREM), reflecting the keenness of both parties to consolidate their long-term joint commitment, and work together to launch initiatives with a sustainable social impact, contributing to supporting children and enhancing their opportunities for education, integration and building a better future.
